title: Fold list-issues.py into query-issues.py or remove the duplicate entrypoint
description:
`scripts/list-issues.py` appears to be just the zero-flag behavior of `scripts/query-issues.py`: both load all issue JSON files, sort by priority, and print `filename: priority title` lines. Maintaining both entrypoints means extra docs, tests, and user-facing surface area for almost no functional difference.

Clean this up by choosing one of these paths:
1. Delete `list-issues.py` and point docs/tests to `query-issues.py` with no flags.
2. Keep `list-issues.py` only as a tiny wrapper around `query-issues.py` so the behavior is defined in one place.

This is low priority, but it is an easy place to remove duplicated maintenance burden.
